messages:
alex_sales: Customer (big-fin) asking if Redwood can support an on‑prem POC where device firmware and OS updates are applied in an air‑gapped environment. They want: signed bundles, USB or courier delivery, and a predictable upgrade cadence. Pricing & risk flags?

mira_se: quick Q — do they need kernel-level patches (firmware blobs) included, or just app/container updates? that changes bundle size and signing model.

alex_sales: they said full appliance updates including custom kernel modules and nvme firmware. security team will want attestation.

chris_ops: technically doable. options: 1) full offline bundles (signed + checksums), 2) delta/patch bundles (smaller, needs patcher on host), 3) signed container images + host-side agent. each has different ops cost.

anita_security: major ask: we need an HSM-backed signing key or customer-managed KMS. on airgapped installs we recommend customer-provided HSM for signing or we escrow a signing workflow in a sealed process. also require binary attestation and reproducible builds.

jen_legal: license note — additional export/security docs and an addendum for offline delivery likely required. Ok to propose 'offsite delivery & SOW' pricing.

alex_sales: rough numbers requested by customer: one POC (3 sites), quarterly updates for 12 months. they asked for a per-update price and a flat engineering onboarding fee.

chris_ops: rough sketch: onboarding SOW = 40-80h eng + security review (~$Xk). per-bundle engineering/validation = 8-16h for full appliance (smaller for deltas). shipping/signing automation work = one-time 20-40h. If they want on-prem signing integration (HSM), add 20h infra + our integration engineering.

mira_se: also callout logistics: USB/sneakernet needs tamperproofing and chain-of-custody. we can provide signed delta tarballs. verification command snippet for their ops: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz`

alex_sales: customer asked about upgrade cadence tradeoffs — monthly vs quarterly vs emergency patches.

chris_ops: monthly = high ops overhead, but we can implement delta diffs to reduce size. quarterly = sweet spot for many customers. emergency CVE hotfixes can be handled as out-of-band paid patches. recommend quarterly + SLA for urgent 72h hotfix with extra fee.

anita_security: note: longer cadence increases attack window. if they insist quarterly, require mandatory security scanning and a rollback playbook in the SOW. also require test harness to validate kernel modules are signed and loaded.

jen_legal: we should add a liability cap and acceptance criteria in SOW for airgapped upgrades (we can't control chain-of-custody once shipped). propose language and signoff form we already use for sealed deployments.

alex_sales: any constraints on packaging format? they mentioned restricted hosts with limited disk and older kernel versions.

mira_se: we can produce 2 flavors: full `bundle.tar.gz` (installer + firmware blobs) and `delta.patch` (apply script). delta requires a small runtime patcher on the host (`redwood-patcher`) which must be preinstalled during first provisioning. if hosts are old, testing matrix grows — add 10-30% testing effort.

chris_ops: adding quantization/stripped binaries helps reduce size but increases validation. also some firmware libs are proprietary, customers must provide redistributable rights or we bundle permissively with an exception.

alex_sales: pricing ask — give me a short bullet I can send the customer.

chris_ops: suggested line items: 1) Onboarding & security integration: one-time $XXk (40–80h). 2) Per-site bundle validation & signing: $Yk per release (8–16h). 3) Emergency CVE patch fee: $Zk guaranteed 72h. 4) HSM/KMS integration: one-time $Wk. 5) Optional on‑site support: day rate. mention shipping costs separate.

mira_se: technical summary to include: support for signed full bundles and delta patches, recommended quarterly cadence, optional HSM integration, requirement for preinstalled patcher for deltas, and chain-of-custody expectations.

deploy-bot: SOW template: https://redwood.internal/sow-templates/airgapped-offline-template.md (react :white_check_mark: to ack)

alex_sales: thanks — I'll draft a proposal. pinging @mira_se @chris_ops for final numbers and an estimate doc we can attach to the SOW. :thumbsup:

mira_se: will provide testing matrix and estimated hours by tomorrow.

chris_ops: I'll add the per-release validation checklist and sign-off steps.

jen_legal: I'll prep the license/escape clause language.

anita_security: I'll sketch HSM options and attestation requirements.

alex_sales: perfect — closing thread. will drop the draft into the deal thread when ready.
